line.comment: * Add-Ons 2.2: Deprecated M7M for AI variable. AI now always includes M7Ms.
* Add-Ons 1.12: Removed Spitfyre since it is now a Private Corp. ship.
* Herobetty: added AP gunner and Phantom
* Add-Ons 1.9: Yaki have more variety with M7M, TP, and M8. Added Argon, Paranid, and Split to M8 and TP but only the Argon Minotaur as another M7M contender.
* Add-Ons 2.0: The new ships mean Yaki now have their own M7M, M8, TS+, and TP+. The previous placeholders from 1.9 have been removed.
* Expanded 2.2: Replaced Phanon M4 with proper Phanon M5.
